title: Arrow and Gibbard Satterthwaite Theorems in Lean
authors: Ruy J. G. B. de Queiroz
summary: We give a source-aligned account of two Lean 4 formalizations of classical finite social-choice impossibility theorems. For a finite nonempty electorate and a finite alternative set containing three distinct alternatives, Arrow’s theorem derives dictatorship from unanimity and independence of irrelevant alternatives. Its proof expands a weakly decisive coalition from one ordered pair to all pairs, then contracts decisive coalitions to a singleton.
